name: school-management-system
description: Nursery & lower-primary school management system (Express + Prisma + Next.js)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.i18n:check: npm --prefix frontend run i18n:check && npm --prefix backend run i18n:check
